title: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in Cozmoslabs Paid Member…
description: A Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Cozmoslabs Paid Member Subscriptions plugin versions up to 3.1.4. The flaw involves improper neutralization of script-related HTML tags, allowing code injection. This vulnerability has a medium severity score of 5.3 and affects versions through 3.1.4.
